scripts.// === Git & Deployment ===: Repository helpers. Review git status before committing or pushing.
scripts.git:sync:tsn: git -C .. fetch tsn-protocol main && git -C .. rebase tsn-protocol/main
scripts.git:commit:push:all: npm run git:sync:tsn && git -C .. add -- tsn-protocol && (git -C .. diff --cached --quiet || git -C .. commit -m "docs: add TSN API reference and privacy guidance") && git -C .. push tsn-protocol HEAD:main
git add -A && git commit -m "Something just got updated! " && git push -u origin main --force
